svg.title: Asked, checked, enforced
svg.desc: Asked, checked, enforced. 1 Asked: AGENTS.md, docs/handoff/STANDARD_AGENT_PROMPT.md, Agent instructions guide work; they can be ignored.. 2 Checked: agentic-kit check, agentic-kit doctor, CI: pull_request, push, python -m pip install --upgrade pip if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install -e ".[dev]" || pip install -e .; fi pip install agentic-project-kit==1.4.0, if [ -d tests ]; then pytest -q; fi, agentic-kit check. 3 Enforced: Required checks can block a merge only when a maintainer enables branch protection in GitHub.. Branch protection is a GitHub setting; the Kit lists it as a setup task.
